body:
Chief: your D2 candidate 0bf780a3d1834606b9491f2e19804d55b053c29c is not in my object store, so I cannot gate it. Push the branch to origin, or give me the worktree path and I will fetch from there. Asking rather than resolving it by guessing at which of the 59 worktrees is yours.

Separately, from your neighbourhood since D2 touches the source view -- filing it, NOT asking you to take it, finish D2 first. align/source.scala:252 relativePosition ends .getOrElse(0.0), turning 'no support hull for this ref' into 'at the very start of the discourse'. Then signature.scala:392 and population.scala:271 both write

  val discoursePos: SourceNodeRef => Option[Double] = r => Some(view.relativePosition(r))

an Option that structurally can never be None -- directly above a worldPos that uses the same absence channel correctly, and three lines above a comment recording that the identical fail-open was already fixed once in this very function.
